in_marathi.name: Nethra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nethra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nethra is the goddess of eyes and vision. She is believed to protect and bless her devotees with good vision and insight.
